scientific_question: Does the complete-lipid joint semantic decoder materially improve measured-Ugi realism over the frozen amine-semantic joint-support baseline while preserving exact assembly and discovery capacity?

criteria: tail morphology is at least as plausible as the frozen baseline
no recurrent unsupported ring or heteroatom pathology is introduced

nonclaims: This is a seed-0 train-fold-only development adjudication, not an across-training-seed or paper-level realism claim.
The adjudicator performs no training, generation, filtering, repair, retry, routing, oracle calls or candidate selection.
The treatment uses only aggregate measured-Ugi training-fold support and no precursor identities, stored component graphs or fragment tokens.
A quantitative pass requires a blinded fixed-index visual review before seed-0 promotion.
Promotion does not establish activity, synthesis success, formulation performance or biological efficacy.
